paite: Huan Nebat tapa kumpipa Jeroboam kum sawm-le-giat alal kum in Judahte tung ah Abijam alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Abijam / (2 Kro 13.1-14.1)
english: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah.

paite: Jerusalem ah kum thum alal a; anu min Maakah, Abishalom tanu ahi.
english: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

paite: Ama a pan thil gilou ahih tengteng ama'n leng ahih sam ahi. Apu David bang in alungtang TOUPA a Pathian lam ah ahoihkim sam kei hi.
english: He walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his God, as the heart of David his father.

paite: Himahleh David ziak in TOUPA a Pathian in anung a, atapa hong dinkhiakna ding leh Jerusalem khua dingkipsak ding in Jerusalem ah khawnvak apia hi.
english: Nevertheless for David’s sake, Yahweh his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him and to establish Jerusalem;

paite: Hit mi Uriah tungtang chih louh in David in TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih ahih ziak leh adamsung teng a hih dia thu apiak peuhmah asel ngei louh ziak in.
english: because David did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

paite: Rehoboam adamsung teng Jeroboam toh akidou gige uhi.
english: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

paite: Abijam tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw? Abijam leh Jeroboam akidou uhi.
english: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

paite: Abijam apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; David khopi ah avui uhi. Ama sik in atapa Asa alal hi.
english: Abijam slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place.

paite: Israel kumpipa Jeroboam kum sawmnih alal kum in Asa bel Judahte tung ah alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Asa / (2 Kro 14.1-5; 15.16—16.6,11-14)
english: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.

paite: Kum sawmli-le-khat Jerusalem ah alal a; anu min Maakah ahi a, amah Abishalom tanu ahi.
english: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

paite: Asa in apu David mah bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
english: Asa did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, as David his father did.

paite: Pasal kizuakte gam a pan adelhkhia a; apute'n milim ana bawl tengteng uh alamang hi.
english: He put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

paite: Anu Maakah leng, milim kihhuai mahmah Asherah abawlsak ziak in, akumpinu hihna atawpsak hi. Amilim bawl ahihsia a, Kidron lui ah ahal hi.
english: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah. Asa cut down her image and burned it at the brook Kidron.

paite: Mun sangte ahihleh alamang kei a; himahleh Asa lungtang adamsung teng in TOUPA lam ah ahoih bukim hi.
english: But the high places were not taken away. Nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with Yahweh all his days.

paite: Apa'n thil ana latsate leh amah mah in ana latsa dangka, dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuan TOUPA' inn ah alalut hi.
english: He brought into Yahweh’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated: silver, gold, and utensils.

paite: Asa leh Israel kumpipa Baasha lal sung teng akidou gige uhi.
heading: Asa Leh Ben-hadad Pankhawmna / (2 Kro 16.1-14)
english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

paite: Israel kumpipa Baasha in Judah ava dou a, Judah kumpipa Asa kiang a lut ding leh pawtkhe ding dalna ding in Ramah khua abawl hi.
english: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

paite: Huchi in Asa in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou om lai dangka leh dangka-eng tengteng ala a, asikhate apia hi. Huchi in kumpipa Asa in Damaskas a om Siria kumpipa Hezion tapate Tabrimon tapa Ben-hadad kiang ah,
english: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered it into the hand of his servants. Then King Asa sent them to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

paite: "Kei leh nang kikal ah leh ka pa leh na pa kikal ah thukhun a-om a; ngai in, thilpiak dangka leh dangka-eng ka hon khak hi. Hong pai inla, Israel kumpipa Baasha in ahon paisanna ding in amah toh na thukhun uh hihsia in," chi in akhak hi.
english: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, like that between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

paite: Ben-hadad in kumpipa Asa thu ana pom a, Israel khuate dou ding in asepaih heutute asawl a, Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maakah khuate, Kinneroth bial tengteng leh Naphtali gam tengteng tan in adou hi.
english: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel Beth Maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Baasha in huai thu ana zaktak in Ramah abawl atawp a, Tirzah ah atengta hi.
english: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.

paite: Kumpipa Asa in Judah gam tengteng ah thu athangsak vialvial hi. Kuamah om awl a-om kei uh. Huchi in Baasha in Ramah khua bawlna dia suang leh sing azatte anawn ua; huaite zang in kumpipa Asa in Mizpah khua leh Benjamin gam a Geba khua abawl hi.
english: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

paite: Asa tanchin dang tengteng, athilhihdan tengteng, athilhih tengtengte leh akho bawlte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw? Himahleh atek lam in akhe ahong nata hi.
english: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

paite: Huchi in a-ihmuta a, apu David khopi ah apute lak ah avui ua; atapa Jehoshaphat asik in alal hi.
english: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.

paite: Jeroboam tapa Nadab Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum nihna ah Israel tung ah alal pan a, Israel tung ah kum nih alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Nadab
english: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih a, apa lampi atawn a, Israelte thilhih akhialsak a, ahihkhelhna pentak ama'n leng ahih sam hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Issakar inkuante lak a mi Ahijah tapa Baasha in amah aguksawm a, Philistiate tan, Gibbethon ah Baasha in athat hi. Nadab leh Israel tengteng in Gibbethon a-um lai uh ahi.
english: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum thumna ah ahi Baasha in athah a, asik a ahong lal.
english: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa ahong hih in Jeroboam inko tengteng athat a; Jeroboam a ding in kuamah ahinghawi kei hi. TOUPA Shiloh a mi asikha Ahijah zang a agensa bang in.
english: As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of Yahweh, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;

paite: Huai bel Israelte thil hihkhialsak a ahih, Jeroboam khelhnate ziak leh TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ahehsak ziak ahi.
english: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which he provoked Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger.

paite: Nadab tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Asa leh Israel kumpipa Baasha alal sung teng un akidou gige uh.
english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum thum na ah Ahijah tapa Baasha Tirzah ah Israel tengteng tung ah alal pan a, kum sawmnih-le-li alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Baasha
english: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih a, Jeroboam lampi zuih azui a, Israelte thil hihkhialsak a ahihkhelhna ahih sam hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.
